descriptions.claude_code: Agent Rally Point — repo-local coordination surface for parallel coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini). Records claims, checks write boundaries, routes handoffs, and exposes room state via the rally CLI. Skills: agent-rally-point (per-session loop), rally-workflows (fan-out + dynamic-workflows protocol), mini-loop (per-task quality gate). Hooks auto-fire on SessionStart + PreToolUse to surface room awareness and deconflict before edits; advisory by default (the edit goes through), with opt-in strict and fail-closed switches that block. Backend: rally CLI (cargo install --path crates/rally-cli).
descriptions.codex: Agent Rally Point coordination skills (agent-rally-point, rally-workflows, mini-loop) for Codex. Repo-local coordination via the rally CLI: claims, write-boundary checks, handoffs, dynamic-workflow task packets.

codex_interface.short_description: Coordinate Codex work through Rally, dynamic workflow task packets, and a per-task quality loop.
codex_interface.long_description: Agent Rally Point gives Codex a repo-local coordination surface for Rally claims, checks, artifacts, handoffs, and dynamic workflow task packets. Three skills: agent-rally-point (per-session loop), rally-workflows (fan-out + dynamic-workflows protocol), mini-loop (per-task assess/plan/execute/judge quality gate).
default_prompt: Run a dynamic workflow through Rally.

agent-rally-point.name: agent-rally-point
agent-rally-point.description: Use when working in a repository that uses Rally/Agent Rally Point for cross-agent coordination, especially at session start, before editing files, when deciding what to do next, handing work to another agent, recording facts/artifacts/decisions, resolving blockers, or coordinating with other coding agents through the `rally` CLI.

mini-loop.name: mini-loop
mini-loop.description: Ultra-light per-task quality loop for Rally Flow / dynamic-workflows fan-out. Wrap each fanned-out task in assess → plan → execute → mini-judge to raise accuracy, with zero tools or scripts. Use when running a workstream task and you want it to actually meet its validation + output contract, not just "be done".

rally-workflows.name: rally-workflows
rally-workflows.description: Use when fanning out work across multiple agents, running a dynamic workflow, coordinating parallel subagents, or splitting a workstream across hosts, terminals, or machines through Agent Rally Point. Defines the workstream descriptor + task-packet protocol and the per-task rally coordination loop. Host-neutral — works for any coding agent.
